Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Mahesh Tewari, Advocate Mr. Shubham Kumar, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Shailendra Kumar Tiwari, Addl.P.P Order No.05 Dated- 13.06.2024 Heard
learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Dhanbad Cyber P.S. Case No. 30 of
2023 registered under sections 420, 467 and 468 of Indian Penal Code and cognizance has been
taken under sections 420, 467, 468, 419 and 120B of Ipc and Sections 66(D) of I.T. Act.

3.  As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner hatching criminal conspiracy with other co-accused person has committed cybercrime with the informant/victim by impersonating himself as Officer of Airtel Company by calling on his mobile phone from different numbers that they would get the tower installed in his filed.

After cheating of more than Rs.20 lakhs from the informant and others,
they switched off their mobile phones.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Either no cheated amount or any incriminating articles has been recovered from the conscious possession of the petitioner and he has no concern with alleged cybercrime.
Co-accused with similar allegation has already been granted regular bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16.05.2024 passed in B.A. No.3797 of 2024.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
It is next submitted that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 23.10.2023 without any rhymes and reasons.
Hence the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5. Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District & Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-special Judge, Vigilance (Cyber Crime, Electricity Act), Dhanbad in connection with Dhanbad Cyber P.S. (Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
